description: This PHP source file defines a data access object (DAO) class 'WorkWeekDao' within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods to save, retrieve, and check non-working days in the context of work weeks, using database interactions and entity classes.

classes.name: WorkWeekDao
classes.description: A DAO class for handling database interactions related to WorkWeek entities, including saving work weeks, retrieving by ID, and checking if a given date is a non-working day.

methods.name: saveWorkWeek
methods.description: Persists a WorkWeek entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getWorkWeekById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkWeek entity from the database by its unique ID.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a specified date is a non-working day based on the WorkWeek configuration. Checks either full-day or half-day non-working status.
